verdict.rationale: Gusto's official CLI ships a `gusto timesheet` command and a bundled timesheet-sync skill that drives the per-cycle timesheet input flow. Its payroll-prep skill maps per-cycle inputs onto a draft payroll, so first-party evidence shows time entries feeding the payroll run. That evidence is thin and comes only through the CLI, which drafts payroll but cannot submit it; the time-off docs cover PTO rather than hourly entries, and nothing mentions overtime. missing for 10: any evidence of overtime calculation or overtime hours flowing into payroll, first-party docs on hourly time-entry APIs feeding regular payroll runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
